age.evidence: Tissues from adult mice were freshly collected and snap-frozen before they were subjected to a simple total membrane isolation protocol.
Adult mice (n = 3; Charles River, Germany) were narcotized with isoflurane then anesthetized with pentobarbital (80 mg/kg).

material_type.evidence: Tissues from adult mice were freshly collected and snap-frozen before they were subjected to a simple total membrane isolation protocol.

Synaptosome-enriched membranes were prepared from whole mouse brain, solubilized with CL-47 (Logopharm GmbH, Germany; 1 ml/mg membrane protein, protease inhibitors added), and resolved on a preparative scale blue native polyacrylamide gradient (BN-PAGE) gel as described.
